gradient.boundary: Post-final-role readout interventions only, not removing upstream bridges or retraining. Both sides changed identically; original global/weights/gain fixed, cross-group/mean correction norms matched per sample. Descriptive frozen-best controls are not new trained methods, stronger teachers, natural-misalignment causes, independent ablations or cross-dataset gains. No test identity enters forward/intervention. Existing benchmark is consumed for development.
